data.name: VoidCraft
data.detailed_description:
One living galaxy. Real stakes.

VoidCraft is an always-online space MMO that brings back what the modern mobile 4X wave

threw away: real-time fleet travel, genuine consequences, and a galaxy you can actually

win. Your fleet is hours away from the enemy's homeworld - and someone else's is hours

from yours.

Travel in real time

Dispatch fleets across a shared star map and watch warp trails draw toward their target

with a live ETA. When a hostile fleet is inbound, the countdown is real - rally your

defenses, call in reinforcements, or ask your alliance for help before it lands.

Watch every battle resolve

Combat plays out as a deterministic replay you can watch and share, second by second.

Build your fleet, pick your moment, and see exactly how it unfolds - volleys, explosions,

and an after-action breakdown of every loss and every haul.

Build an empire your way

Mine, build, and research across your worlds. Climb the tech tree from Energy to Lasers

to Plasma. Scout rivals with tiered espionage. Raid, recycle, ally, betray - the

diplomacy is as sharp as the weapons.

Find the relics

Relics lie scattered across the galaxy. Find them, use them to power your empire - and

find out why the galaxy resets every 6 months.

A fair start, every cycle

Every 6 months the galaxy goes through a Big Bang: empires are archived into the era hall

of fame and a fresh shard spins up. No entrenched whales, no dead servers - everyone gets

a real shot.

Free to play. No pay-to-win. Ever.

Cosmetic monetisation only. No gacha, no vaults, no buying your way past another commander.

One universe. Every device.

Play one persistent, always-online universe that keeps running even when you log off.

data.short_description: A real-time space strategy MMO where your colony keeps working, your fleets keep moving, and the galaxy remembers every choice. Travel in real time, watch every battle resolve, raid and ally across one living galaxy that resets every 6 months. Free to play. No pay-to-win, ever.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz (x86-64)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: WebGL 2.0 capable GPU with 1 GB VRAM (Intel HD 520 or newer)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a persistent internet connection (always-online game).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 2 GB VRAM (GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560 or newer)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires a persistent internet connection (always-online game).
